technology.technologyDescriptionAndIncludedProcesse:
Process includes roasting and cracking of the rare earth concentrate with 98% sulphuric acid at 500°C in a rotary kiln. For the following separation of the different rare earth oxides solvent extraction (SX) is used. The obtained rare earth oxide product has a purity of up to 99.9%.

# Included processes
The process includes raw materials, processing chemicals and processing energy, emissions to water and wastes. Transport and infrastructure are estimated. The multi output-process "rare earth oxide production from bastnasite" delivers the co-products "cerium concentrate, 60% cerium oxide, at plant", "lanthanum oxide, at plant", "neodymium oxide, at plant","praseodymium oxide, at plant", "samarium europium gadolinium concentrate 94% rare earth oxide, at plant". The revenue is used as allocation scheme.
